lines.text: Hezekiah invites Israel and Judah to the house of the LORD in Jerusalem for a Passover in the second month.
Couriers carry the king's letters from Beersheba to Dan, calling the people to return to the LORD.
Ephraim and Manasseh mock the couriers, but a great crowd gathers and throws incense altars into the Jordan River.
The priests and Levites are proud, and Hezekiah pleads for those who ate unpurified, and the LORD heals them.
The assembly agrees to keep seven more days, and Jerusalem has great rejoicing unlike any since the days of Solomon.
